## Step 2. Fix the grader and close the selftest gap

The selftest oracle used the same letter case as the answer key. That is why the gate did not catch this bug.

Change to `spe/evals/harness/grader.js`:

```js
function normPriority(p) {
  return String(p ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
}

function priorityMatch(got, want) {
  return normPriority(got) === normPriority(want);
}
```

New selftest cases:

```js
selftest("priority case", () => {
  assert(priorityMatch("p1", "P1"));      // lowercase must pass
  assert(priorityMatch(" P1 ", "P1"));    // whitespace must pass
  assert(!priorityMatch("P2", "P1"));     // wrong value must fail
  assert(!priorityMatch("", "P1"));       // empty must fail
});
```

1. Run the full selftest. The oracle must pass, and empty and wrong answers must fail.
2. Audit the grader for bugs in the other direction, meaning checks that are too lenient. A search that starts from a miss tends to find only bugs that lower scores. If the audit finds a lenient bug, I log it as F8, regrade, and halt.
